declienting: Reused the library's SearchInput component for the search field — its input, submit, clear, and polite results live region carry over — instead of re-implementing a field; the results panel rides through SearchInput's `results` slot.

Extracted the dialog shell (SSR portal gate, focus trap, scroll lock, Escape-to-close, focus restoration) into src/lib/dialog.client.ts (useDialog), now shared with Modal, rather than duplicating Modal's inline shell.
Reused the shared src/lib/CloseButton primitive for the dismiss control, shared with Modal.
Removed the search-API / results-feed wiring; results and suggestions arrive through the resultsPanel slot and the overlay emits query and submit events via onQueryChange / onSubmit.
Removed the CMS field bindings for the heading and quick links; heading is a required prop and quick links a slot.

Mapped component tokens onto library semantic tokens: panel surface to surface-raised, backdrop to surface-scrim, heading/description text to text-primary/text-secondary, panel elevation to shadow-overlay, bottom corners to radius-medium; the field and close control map their own tokens through SearchInput and CloseButton.
Dropped the decorative brand glow asset; the panel surface is a token.

Dropped the client's bespoke suggestion-list arrow-key navigation over a fixed suggestion list; results are a caller-owned slot in a polite live region, so option-level activedescendant is the caller's responsibility. Kept the dialog focus trap, Escape/backdrop dismissal, focus restoration, and the idle-to-active state split.
